hook:
A whole game, one board.
No wires at all.
kicker: M5 Cardputer ADV: LCD, keyboard, speaker

roles.cardputer-adv: Runs the game: LCD, keyboard, speaker

igCaption: Brick Blaster runs entirely on the M5 Cardputer ADV, no wiring and no microSD. The 240x135 LCD draws through an off-screen sprite so nothing tears, and the 56-key keyboard steers the paddle. Each brick row is a note of a pentatonic scale, so clearing rows walks up the scale and you can hear your progress.
ytTitle: M5 Cardputer ADV Brick Blaster game, no wiring #shorts
ytDescription: A full brick breaker game on the M5 Cardputer ADV using only the built-in LCD, keyboard and speaker. Each brick row plays a note of a pentatonic scale, so the sound tracks your score. Open it in your browser: https://velxio.dev/example/cardputer-adv-brick-blaster
